model: GDA-1600 gas detection controller (ProtoNode BACnet Protocol Converter Kit)
equipment_type: Gas detection controller (sensor) via BACnet gateway
applies_to: Bacharach GDA-1600 16-channel gas detection controllers connected through the FieldServer ProtoNode BACnet converter kit.
summary: A FieldServer ProtoNode reads the GDA-1600 over Modbus and serves 300 read-only Analog Inputs: per-channel tag, units and value text blocks, numeric channel values and readings, channel status and sensor life, plus alarm, fault, call and LED status objects that each cover all 16 channels, and the relay status.
notes: Objects 1-224 carry text: each channel tag spans 8 objects, each units string and ASCII value 3 objects. The guide prints one name per block, so every object in a block shares that name.
The guide gives no units or scaling for Channel Value and Channel Reading.
Each '1-16' object reports all 16 channels in one value; the guide does not say how it is encoded.
All objects are read-only; the kit offers no writes.
The kit manual only gives the ProtoNode IP settings; it does not cover BACnet MS/TP.

source.title: BACnet Protocol Converter Kit for Use with Bacharach GDA-1600 Controller - Installation Manual

integration.summary: Read the channel readings for the channels in use, the per-channel status and the packed alarm and fault words; the text blocks are only needed for display.
gotchas: Each 1-16 status object covers all channels; the guide does not give the encoding, so check it on site.
Text blocks (tag, units, ASCII value) are split across several AIs.
